meta.title: The Video Call
meta.textType: story: the one video call, with a feeling that the text does not state

paragraphs: On Tuesday, March sixteenth, the video call opened at half past four in the school library. Lily, Mia, Leo, and May sat at a table in front of a laptop, and Teacher Kim stood behind them. That morning, Teacher Kim downloaded the call program. Ms. Ong's mail was an invitation to the video call, and her class was online. The pen-pal children waved on the screen, and they looked friendly, so Lily and Leo waved back. "Hello, can you see us?" asked Leo. "Yes, we can, and good afternoon, Explorers," said Ms. Ong. "It is half past five here in Singapore."

Lily had a printed sheet in her hands. She printed it at four o'clock on the library printer. The printer stood on a shelf behind her. The sheet had a small drawing of a violin and the words "Questions for Grace." Lily's first question was about Grace's violin. She read it two times, and then she looked at the screen. Mia moved close to Lily and whispered, "A face and a voice in one box, what an invention!"

Then the voices stopped. The children on the screen opened and closed their mouths, but nobody heard a word. "Perhaps the microphone is off," said May. "The sound may be a problem," said Teacher Kim. "The speaker might be off, too," she added. She clicked on the speaker picture, and the room stayed quiet. Everybody waited for one minute. Then the voices came back, and Ms. Ong asked, "Can you hear us now?" "Yes!" shouted Leo.

Ravi talked with Leo about badminton, and Nadia asked Mia about her white kitten. "Alex says that he talks about robots all the time," said Ms. Ong with a smile, and everybody laughed. "Do your robots have names?" asked Leo. "Yes, all of them," said Alex. Grace waved at Lily and said, "Hello, Lily!" "Hello, Grace," said Lily. Then she looked at her paper and said nothing.

The time went fast, and Ms. Ong said, "The call may end soon." "Thank you, Explorers, and please write to us." "Goodbye!" said the children on the screen, all together. At ten to five, the screen went dark. Teacher Kim closed the laptop lid a little.

Lily, Mia, Leo, and May stood up and packed their bags. Lily looked at her sheet again and said, "I forgot to ask Grace." "Write it in your email," said May. Leo gave a thumbs up, and May pointed at Lily's sheet. Lily put the sheet in her notebook.
text.summary: The Explorers make a video call with the pen-pal class in the school library. The sound stops for a minute, and Lily has a question for Grace, but she looks at her paper and says nothing.
